defects.M9-DEV-086: TaskTerminal visible effect always focused xterm over an existing input/editor/file-control/dialog/menu owner. Six production-component focus tests fail against r37 source. Preserve protected editable/file workspace owners and popup focus; body/explicit task navigation still focus a visible writable terminal. Popup establishing focus takes priority even if old terminal still owns the active element. Ten component tests green; real packaged input/search/editor/M8 confirmation and task switching passed.

sourceBaseline.driverVersionBoundary: Final input/scope run precedes atomic receiver control-file writes and self-hash addition only; exact executed script preserved. Final standalone P01 exercises atomic control and matches current driver hash. Production source unchanged throughout all App runs.

outputContinuity.method: Actual native event stream and own receiver independently numbered1..101. Thirty real tree/file/panel open-close and pointer width drags; same xterm DOM each cycle. Actual trusted wheel visits history until1 is visible, then walks all pages; visible rows consecutive and full rendered union exactly equals native sequence. No PTY exit/history replay observed.

basis: P04 requires five actual seconds of dragging, frame coalescing, unchanged-size suppression, correct final geometry and no sustained main-process blocking.

Duplicate size suppression and nonzero dimensions are direct behavioral requirements. Frame count is an aggregate App bound with two boundary messages; exact coalescing is additionally verified with a deterministic scheduler, not inferred from aggregate timing alone.

250ms maximum event-loop lag and 100 samples at 25ms are pre-execution engineering gates for this local fixture, not observed Codex performance or a general all-device SLA. No minimum display refresh rate is invented.
budget.changePolicy: Preserve E1 and failures. Do not loosen a gate to count the current execution as passed.

performanceRegression.boundary: Same DEV085 E1, unchanged; solo run after build/code tests and prior App closed. P01 itself has no new throughput/FPS budget.

driverCorrections: After fixture tasks and reload, actual start/resume must attach their terminals before observations. Previous timeout preserved; both terminal baselines established through real UI first.
Tree cannot be clicked while hidden. Each of30 cycles now closes/reopens the file panel and reads its real ready tree before opening file; no fake tree state.
One huge wheel did not bring first output into view. Record state-based actual upward wheels until marker1, then collect every downward viewport; original native continuity was already green.

Own App backgroundThrottling=false keeps document.visibilityState visible when BrowserWindow.hide returns not visible. Validate actual native isVisible for hide/show; do not require an unrelated HTML hidden transition or force DOM state.

KeyEvent.key for Space must be the actual space character; code remains Space. Original invalid key attempt preserved; real confirmation Space now returns to retained export form without terminal input.
M8 export input/description/animation readiness is explicit. Original unconfirmed-close precondition failure retained; no unsupported attribution to App behavior.

Final unchanged-all-sources assertion was inappropriate for deliberately edited files under existing R07.3 three-second autosave. Assert exact expected full text for two explicitly edited files, untouched sentinel inode/hash/mtime, exact terminal completed line and zero other input instead. Original failure preserved; product rule unchanged.
boundaries: A actual normal packaged UI/native paths; setup only public IPC. Own native window controls and passive native event/DOM observers do not replace original authorization/results/stores or terminal sinks. Own Python runner only reads lines/numbers output and never executes input/models.

P02 receiver gets exactly one31-byte UTF8 line including one CR, zero additional file/shortcut/confirmation input. T2 receives0bytes. P05 native window visibility for filter, CodeMirror, search and actual M8 confirmation; real TaskView visible-prop transition protected by separate component U with tiny xterm focus adapter, not mislabeled native A.

P06 restores each task file scope/content and same PTY/PID while T1 continues output. Deliberate file edits may autosave under unchanged R07.3; they are not claimed to stay dirty forever. File tabs cannot substitute task navigation.

P08 actual new project creation, additional directory, label edit, export form/nested confirmation and import choose screen. Cancel before native save/export/import-file picker. Original project directories/database/server configs unchanged and no external DB/server resource configured or written.

M4 legacy DOM.click smoke has seven technical checks and fake CLI. It does not complete P09 voice, real resources/model, global shortcuts or other platforms. No new prototype UI source: these five cases requireA; existing prototype geometry/design untouched.

42 fresh affected code tests are not a full-suite run. Historical1731 union retains two old external CLI opt-ins unselected. Six initial focus failures are U; no claim that all occurred in actual packaged A.
Oldr4/r6 pending57bytes, AIS directory, daily credentials/resources and system clipboard untouched. No commit/push/merge/tag/release.
